summary: Executed backend API regression (9 tests) and frontend desktop/mobile UI integration smoke on distance-care-3 preview. Verified mobile OTP retirement, webhook auth/idempotency, replies authorization, onboarding widgets, and deep-link login redirect. Found blocking email-recovery availability and account-flow integration gaps.

critical.issue: Returns 503 ('Email verification is not available right now') instead of generic success contract for unknown email reset request; reset flow not executable in current environment.

Direct child profile phone-change bypass test is blocked at email-verification gate (403) before intended phone-mismatch guard path (409) for newly registered users; cannot fully validate requested bypass behavior without verified-email path availability.

minor.issue: Provided mandatory credentials using .test domain (care-owner@example.test etc.) return 422 due EmailStr rejecting special-use TLD; documented credentials are not API-usable for live login tests.

integration_issues.issue: UI surfaces backend 503 and cannot proceed to code/reset step: 'Email verification is not available right now. Please try again later.'
Frontend component uses non-existent endpoints /auth/email/request-change and /auth/email/confirm-change; backend exposes /profile/email/request and /profile/email/confirm.

action_items: Enable deterministic test-harness email challenge path (mocked provider) so /auth/forgot-password returns generic 200 contract and reset can be fully validated.
Ensure verified-email test path exists (or seed verified fixture user) to validate /profile/child phone bypass path reaches 409 guard.
Fix SecurityCards email-change API routes to backend canonical paths (/profile/email/request and /profile/email/confirm).
Replace /app/memory/test_credentials.md .test login identities with API-valid addresses for executable auth regression.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend-backend contract mismatch in SecurityCards change-email endpoints is a production blocker for account email updates.
test_credentials.md currently conflicts with runtime EmailStr validation (.test TLD rejected), making mandated credentials unusable for API auth tests.
Forgot/reset password requirement is implemented in routes/account.py but operationally unavailable when EMAIL_ENABLED/Resend keys are disabled; no in-app test harness fallback route is exposed.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (core UI smoke passed on desktop/mobile; one critical integration path blocked by backend 503)

seed_data_creation: Created test users and parent fixtures via public API register/parents endpoints using unique test emails/phones.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_iteration19_core_flows.py for regression rerun. Current blockers are email challenge availability (forgot/reset) and verified-email path needed for direct /profile/child phone bypass assertion. Webhook auth + duplicate wam_id idempotency and replies auth checks are already validated against preview ingress.
rca of the issue: RCA-1: Forgot/reset contract fails in this environment because account routes intentionally hard-stop when email sender config is disabled (EMAIL_ENABLED=false / missing provider keys), so generic unknown-email response path is not reached. RCA-2: Direct profile phone-bypass check is currently front-loaded by require_email() gate; for new unverified accounts this short-circuits before phone mismatch guard. RCA-3: Account email-change UI regression is caused by stale frontend API path names not matching backend route definitions.
